risks.risk: Tire size is unknown, so the buyer may not be able to fit it to their vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall showing the full size marking (e.g., 195/65R15) on each tire.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as wrong/unknown fit risk (worst case: buyer cannot confirm compatibility).

risks.risk: Age/DOT date is unknown; older tires can fail even with good tread.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code/date on the sidewall for each tire.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older/unknown age (worst case: treat as not guaranteed for long life).

risks.risk: Condition beyond tread (sidewall cracks, bulges, punctures, internal damage) is not visible.
risks.proof: Photos of each tire’s full sidewall (both sides) and a close-up of any suspected damage; also a photo of the tire standing to show bulges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/unknown integrity (worst case: assume reduced reliability).

risks.risk: Brand/model is not readable; pricing depends heavily on exact model and performance class.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full brand and model name on the sidewall (not cropped).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used tires with good tread only (worst case: no premium model).
